name: Reclusion
source: The year is 2013. An unnamed protagonist, deep in debt, suffering from obesity, sociophobia, and probably other mental disorders, is locked up indefinitely in his apartment. Does he get out alive and sane? It depends only on a strange companion from the future (player) who has established a telepathic connection with him.
